trailhead.label: The square by the town hall, Chianocco, the board’s start

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
The board advises against the hottest months: the slope is sunny; go in autumn, winter or spring.
Path 541 is steep at the start and parts are mountain paths (T2): take it slowly with an older dog.
Stretches on hamlet lanes between Margrit and Molè: keep your dog on a short lead there.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
